描述_EN: ecru pastilles are placed on either side between each medallion. tapestry square adorned with a frieze of highly stylized acanthus leaf scrolls, simplified into a frieze of red medallions stamped with "s" motifs. At the center of the room is a square, each corner of which is occupied by an ecru-colored dot. the piece is surrounded by an ecru thread margin. the square houses a circular pattern formed by a series of circles with a black dot. the linen canvas is visible on the reverse. in the center of this motif, another shape can be made out (a trace of unbleached thread).
描述_ZN: ecru pastilles被放置在每个奖章之间的两侧。 方形挂毯上装饰有高度风格化的刺桐叶卷轴，简化为印有 "s "图案的红色奖章的楣板。 房间的中央是一个正方形，每个角落都被一个赤褐色的小点占据。 该作品被边缘的ecru线所包围。 广场上有一个由一系列圆圈与黑点组成的圆形图案。 亚麻布在背面可见。 在这个图案的中心，可以看到另一个形状（未漂白线的痕迹）。
时期: 埃及 拜占庭统治时期
